KOS ListenFree 是 NextKDE 基于开源项目 ListenFr:
KOS ListenFree is NextKDE's desktop adaptation of the open-source ListenFree project.

ListenFree provides the original interface, playback logic and music engine. NextKDE maintains Linux compatibility, system media controls, desktop and lock-screen lyrics, themes, windows and source integration. Thanks to the original author and all contributors. The copyrights and licenses of the project and its dependencies are preserved.

This version is maintained and distributed by NextKDE. Get updates from NextKDE to retain desktop integration; upstream ListenFree releases do not include these adaptations.
